parsed.name: Autolab电化学工作站
parsed.description: Autolab电化学工作站是一类用于电化学实验的恒电位/恒电流测试仪器，可控制电化学池的电位与电流并采集响应信号。它常用于循环伏安、计时电流/计时电位、电化学阻抗谱（FRA/EIS）以及电池、腐蚀、传感器和电催化等研究。
parsed.description_en: The Autolab electrochemical workstation is a potentiostat/galvanostat for electrochemical experiments. It controls the potential or current of an electrochemical cell and records the response signal. It is commonly used for cyclic voltammetry, chrono methods, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (FRA/EIS), and studies of batteries, corrosion, sensors, and electrocatalysis.
